title: Multi model multimodal and multi agent innovations in Azure AI: Cedric Vidal
talk_summary: A Microsoft AI Advocate demos Azure AI Studio capabilities: multimodal GPT-4o reading menus and infrastructure photos, a video translation service, a 1,600-model catalog with serverless token billing, model benchmarks, RAG grounding, evaluation metrics, and a code-interpreter agent that parses a GPX file and draws a map. It is almost entirely product demos with no engineering detail on multi-agent orchestration, cost control, or review quality.

takeaways.technique: Built-in eval metrics on prompt/model changes
takeaways.what_they_do: Runs a small labeled dataset through coherence/groundedness/relevance metrics whenever the system prompt or model changes, to confirm behavior did not regress.
takeaways.evidence_quote: when you make modifications to the system prompt or you change your models on your application you want to make sure that it continues to work as expected

takeaways.what_they_do: Catalog exposes accuracy and other benchmark metrics across many models so you pick per use case instead of defaulting to the biggest model.
takeaways.evidence_quote: we also have the model benchmarks where we compare not all but we compare many of the models that are available in the catalog

takeaways.technique: Serverless token billing vs provisioned GPUs
takeaways.what_they_do: Contrasts pay-per-token serverless deployment (no infra to manage) with bring-your-own-GPU where you pay whether or not the endpoint is used.
takeaways.evidence_quote: bringing your own infrastructure means basically that you uh rent for gpus that you pay for gpus whether you use the endpoint or not

takeaways.what_they_do: LLM generates and executes Python in a sandbox to parse an unfamiliar XML format and produce a map, without the user knowing the format.
takeaways.evidence_quote: the llm is going to automatically generate python code and execute it in a sandbox to analyze the file that I uploaded

takeaways.what_they_do: Grounds model answers in uploaded documents via an index so it can answer about post-cutoff information.
takeaways.evidence_quote: I can select an index to do rag retrieval augmented generation where I can ground the my model into my own documents
